purpose: Build the nine-ObsID integrated Bullet spectrum and derive target-blind Fe-K response weights that transport the nine measured detector-gain covariances to every frozen source-only region.
claim_boundary: This response transport does not fit or inspect a source line, temperature, abundance, redshift or velocity and cannot admit a Sigma source or open Abell 2146.

weight_definition.cell_contribution: source PHA EXPOSURE times source ARF SPECRESP at observed Fe-K
weight_definition.region_obsid_weight: sum cell contributions within region and ObsID, normalized over the nine ObsIDs
weight_definition.gain_mean_transport: p_effective = sum_i weight_i p_i for p=(intercept,slope)
weight_definition.gain_covariance_transport: C_effective = sum_i weight_i^2 C_i because the per-ObsID calibration measurements are independent
weight_definition.gain_correction_dispersion: Report the response-weighted RMS dispersion of the nine fitted mean gain corrections separately from covariance uncertainty because a mixture of differently shifted responses is not exactly one shifted response.
weight_definition.later_primary_use: propagate C_effective to the source redshift interval without shifting source data
weight_definition.later_corrected_use: use p_effective only in the explicitly labeled gain-corrected sign-topology robustness branch
